Soar to the world's most spectacular snowy peaks with Saudia. Enjoy world-class comfort, exceptional in-flight dining, and generous baggage allowances for all your winter gear. Your elevated alpine adventure starts the exact moment you step on board.

Ski Gateways You can travel to now

Discover a world of winter wonder. Whether you crave the dramatic vertical drops of the Swiss Alps, or the chic après-ski scene in France, we connect you to the ultimate snowy playgrounds. Choose your summit and let the adventure begin.

GVA Geneva travel Your gateway to the French and Swiss Alps, offering seamless access to world-class ski resorts set against breathtaking lakeside scenery.
ZRH Zurich travel Discover the perfect blend of vibrant city life and effortless access to Switzerland’s premier alpine ski destinations.
MXP Milan travel Begin your journey to Italy’s iconic ski resorts, where majestic alpine landscapes meet refined Italian elegance.
CDG Paris travel Seamlessly connect to the French Alps, home to some of Europe’s most celebrated and expansive ski experiences.
VIE Vienna travel A refined gateway to Austria’s renowned ski resorts, known for their charm, authenticity, and pristine slopes.
MUC Munich travel Your ideal starting point to the Bavarian Alps, combining rich heritage with easy access to outstanding ski destinations.
JFK New York travel Connect effortlessly to North America’s premier ski destinations, from the Rockies to the Northeast’s finest resorts.
IAD Washington DC travel Enjoy convenient access to exceptional ski experiences across the East Coast and beyond.
YYZ Toronto travel A gateway to Canada’s legendary ski regions, from nearby slopes to the iconic peaks of the Rockies.

                    Benefits of Booking Your Ski Trip with Saudia

                    Experience the unmatched comfort of Saudi hospitality in the sky. Book a flight to your dream ski location with Saudia and enjoy:

                    • Spacious seating and in-flight entertainment
                    • Authentic Saudi meals served with warmth
                    • Convenient flight schedules
                    • Generous baggage allowances and world-class service

                    Travel Essentials when Packing for Your Ski Trip

                    Pack smart and stay warm. Preparing for the mountain means bringing the right gear for both action and après-ski relaxation. Here is your ultimate packing checklist:

                    • Thermal Base Layers: Lock in the heat with high-quality, moisture-wicking tops and bottoms.
                    • Waterproof Outerwear: Invest in a durable, insulated ski jacket and pants to conquer the elements.
                    • Protective Gear: Never forget your well-fitted helmet and UV-blocking ski goggles.
                    • Warm Accessories: Bring insulated gloves, a cozy beanie, and a neck gaiter to shield against the mountain chill.
                    • Après-Ski Comfort: Pack comfortable snow boots and warm casual wear for exploring the village after a day on the slopes.

                    Stopover flights to Ski Destinations from Anywhere in the World

                    Explore our Stopover offer and seamlessly turn one vacation into two. Spend up to 96 hours exploring the dynamic streets of Riyadh, the historic coastal charm of Jeddah, or the breathtaking ancient landscapes of AlUla; all easily accessible with a complimentary transit visa.

                    FAQs

                    Skiing Destinations

                    Planning your ski trip should be as fun as your ski vacation. Read our answers to common questions to help you prepare for a perfect ski getaway.

                    When is the best time to go skiing?

                    Chase the snow between December and March for the peak ski season. Keep an eye on local forecasts, as some high-altitude resorts open their lifts earlier or keep them running well into the spring depending on conditions.

                    Are skiing destinations suitable for beginners?

                    Absolutely. Most major ski resorts feature gentle slopes, dedicated practice zones, and world-class ski schools designed to get you carving with confidence in no time.

                    How much does a skiing trip usually cost?

                    Your budget depends entirely on your travel style. Factor in flights, accommodation, lift passes, and gear rentals. Whether you want a cozy, budget-friendly chalet or a luxurious ski-in/ski-out resort experience, there are excellent options available.

                    Do I need travel insurance for a ski trip?

                    Protect your peace of mind. We highly recommend securing travel insurance that specifically covers winter sports and unexpected medical emergencies before you travel.

                    Are skiing destinations suitable for non-skiers?

                    Definitely. The mountains offer magic for everyone. Trade skis for snowshoes, unwind in thermal alpine spas, explore charming local boutiques, or simply sip hot cocoa while taking in the panoramic views.

                    Can I book a multi-city flight itinerary to visit more than one ski destination?

                    Absolutely. Use our multi-city booking feature to build the ultimate winter itinerary. Fly into one hub, like Geneva, and fly out of another, like Milan, so you never have to ski the same mountain twice.

                    How long do I need to book a ski trip for?

                    Plan for 3 to 7 days. A long weekend is perfect for a quick powder fix, while a full week gives you plenty of time to master the mountain and fully immerse yourself in the alpine lifestyle.

                    What should I do if I have a long layover on my way to my ski destination?

                    Unwind in our luxurious AlFursan lounges between flights. For longer layovers in Saudi Arabia, apply for a Stopover visa with your flight to step outside the airport, soak up the sun, and explore the Kingdom’s rich culture.
